#
# The `tessera_testing` suite (issue #454). Its own directory for the reason every other slice's is:
# the root `tests/unit/CMakeLists.txt` stays the single index, and this slice never has to edit a file
# another lane is appending to.
#
# Both executables are host-only: the component fixture is generated by the target-built
# `tessera_codegen` at build time, which a cross-compiling build cannot run.

if (CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING OR NOT TARGET tessera_codegen_cli)
    return()
endif ()

# The fixture component (`CounterCard.tsx`): the one the acceptance test and the guide both use. Its
# developer class is written by the CLI's own scaffold step and committed, following ADR-040's "the
# generated base is regenerated wholesale, the developer class is scaffolded once".
set(_testing_fixture_src ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/testing)
set(_testing_fixture_gen ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated)
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${_testing_fixture_gen}/CounterCard.g.hpp
           ${_testing_fixture_gen}/CounterCard.hpp
           ${_testing_fixture_gen}/CounterCard.cpp
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${_testing_fixture_gen}
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tessera_codegen_cli> --write
            --out ${_testing_fixture_gen} --namespace card --salt card
            ${_testing_fixture_src}/CounterCard.tsx
    DEPENDS tessera_codegen_cli ${_testing_fixture_src}/CounterCard.tsx
    COMMENT "Generating the tessera_testing counter fixture"
    VERBATIM)

add_library(tessera_testing_counter STATIC
    ${_testing_fixture_gen}/CounterCard.cpp
    ${_testing_fixture_gen}/CounterCard.g.hpp)
target_include_directories(tessera_testing_counter PUBLIC ${_testing_fixture_gen})
target_link_libraries(tessera_testing_counter PUBLIC
    tessera_scene
    tessera_text_edit
    tessera_animation)
target_compile_features(tessera_testing_counter PUBLIC cxx_std_23)

# The acceptance test of the issue: "The Counter and a form sample each have a test written only with
# this API: a tap increments, a failed network fake shows the error state, a back event pops a route."
# Every assertion in it comes from `tessera_testing`; it links no paint, no GPU and no window backend,
# which is what lets it run on every lane.
add_executable(testing_acceptance_tests
    acceptance_tests.cpp)

target_link_libraries(testing_acceptance_tests PRIVATE
    tessera_testing
    tessera_testing_counter
    # The three services the cases drive: the scripted network back end, the route stack, and the
    # service contract. `tessera_testing` already links the first and the third; naming the navigation
    # module here is what keeps the kit from depending on a module an app may not adopt.
    tessera_appfw_navigation
    tessera_appfw_net)

add_test(NAME testing_acceptance COMMAND testing_acceptance_tests)

# The kit's own contract: the deterministic stack is actually deterministic, `advance` moves time the
# way it claims, `find`/`tap`/`type_text` report absence instead of asserting, and the file-system fake
# behaves like the seam it doubles.
add_executable(testing_kit_tests
    kit_tests.cpp)

target_link_libraries(testing_kit_tests PRIVATE
    tessera_testing
    tessera_testing_counter)

add_test(NAME testing_kit COMMAND testing_kit_tests)

# The isolation rule, as a check rather than a comment: no shipping target may link `tessera_testing`.
# This is a configure-time test over the *source* CMake files, not over the built graph, because the
# promise is about what the repository declares: a `target_link_libraries(... tessera_testing)` under
# `src/app`, `src/appfw`, `src/ui`, `src/rendering` or `samples/` is the edit that would break it, and
# catching it here names the file instead of leaving it to a reviewer's memory.
add_test(NAME testing_isolated
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
            -DSOURCE_DIR=${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}
            -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/check_isolated.cmake)
